# Invictus AI

> Complete patient growth system for dental clinics in India, integrating conversion-focused websites, hyper-local Meta Ads, and automated Google reputation management.

## Docs

- [Home](https://invictus-ai.in/): Core overview of the Invictus AI patient growth system. Highlights the 60-day results guarantee for dental clinics.
- [Clinic Website Service](https://invictus-ai.in/services/clinic-website): Details on custom, high-converting websites designed specifically for dental clinics to turn local traffic into booked appointments.
- [Meta Ads Service](https://invictus-ai.in/services/meta-ads): Hyper-local Instagram and Facebook ad campaigns targeting patients within a 5km radius of the clinic.
- [Reputation Management](https://invictus-ai.in/services/reputation-management): Automated systems to generate 5-star Google reviews via WhatsApp/SMS after patient visits.
- [Free Website Audit](https://invictus-ai.in/tools/website-audit): Free comprehensive technical and conversion audit for dental clinic websites.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2023
- Founder: Sahil Bagul

- Industry: Digital Marketing for Dental Clinics
- Differentiators: 60-day risk-free growth guarantee, fully managed system (ads + website + reputation), strict dental clinic exclusivity.
